message:
Welcome to Shooterland! This first level may seem daunting, but you can do it! All you need to do to finish a level is to simply defeat all of the enemies on the screen. See those yellow guys? They're called Cronies! Adjoin 3 of the same foods next to them and they'll die! Any time you adjoin 3 or more of the same food they disappear and you get money! But, don't let Rosco steal all of your money or you lose! 
 
 Good luck!

The objects you shoot are called "thingies." When you connect 3 or more of the same thingy together it's called a "combo." Combos of 3 earn you one dollar. Every additional thingy in a combo after 3 adds another dollar to your earnings. (Combo of 4 earns 2$, combo of 5 earns 3$) 
 
 In other words, go for big combos for more money!

Once Rosco emerges from his lair, he'll keep stealing money from you (right out of your piggy bank) and returning it to his tree stump. Each trip he steals 1 dollar from you. Be sure to keep an eye on how much money you have! It's displayed on this menu bar once you begin the level.
Randomly spread throughout the thingies Poindexter and Mary shoot are BOWLING BOMBS! They will destroy anything you shoot them into - this includes Cronies as well as thingies!

Shooterland is not only a game of thought but a game of speed! Each level has a special time-to-beat for it. If you beat the special time, you acquire the STAR for the level! The energy in these stars is harnessed to transport the shooters to different worlds!

Notice how all of the enemies have a glowing red aura around them? That is their evil aura. It helps you pick them out during gameplay! 
 
 Also, there is an enemy counter at the top of this menu once the game begins. It tells you how many of each enemy is left in the level.
Rosco will keep speeding up the longer you play. See the timer next to his lair? When that timer drops to zero, Rosco will speed up!

Those grey blocks are impossible to destroy, even with bowling bombs. They're made out of Vilithizium, the most dense rock in all of Shooterland! These blocks are fairly light, however , and can be moved around with weights once you learn how to use them.

Uh Oh! 
 There's a lot of Cronies here! But, since they're so close, a couple well placed combos will take them out! Unfortunately, you don't get more money for taking out more than one Cronie in a combo.

Poindexter and Mary are twins. They used to adjoined at the bubble! Due to some odd physical condition resulting from this, they can only shoot at the same time! If either Poindexter's or Mary's shot is blocked then neither of them can shoot! Keep your shooting paths clear or else you'll be stuck!

Hmmmm... 
 What a clever Cronie. How can we kill him if he's hiding behind those grey blocks? There's a solution! Buy a WEIGHT by pressing the store button below your money total. Drag the desired weight onto either Poindexter or Mary. The number on each weight is how many objects the weight can push and also how many Cronies it can crush. Weights can only crush enemies! Thingies and blocks cannot be crushed!

Looks like you have to use weights again for this one! Here's a quick description on how weights work. First, a weight pushes as many objects as it can (signified by the number on the weight) until it has to stop. Then, the weight crushes as many enemies as it can (also the number on the weight) beginning from the enemies nearest to it. Sound confusing? You will surely get the hang of it!
Better save up the cash! You need to buy a 3-weight for this level. That Cronie thinks he's so safe in there. We'll show him, huh? CRUSH HIM!

The Cronies are of the Spherifacius genus (as well as Mr. and Mrs. Pac-Man). The Pac family decided to cut ties with the Cronies after a bitter dispute regarding the United States foreign policy. The Cronies have been evil ever since.

Remember, you have three ways to kill Cronies at your disposal. You can kill them with combos, bombs, and now weights. It's up to you to decide which is quickest and most efficient. This is a great skill you will soon develop!

That Cronie seems like he's impossible to get to. Luckilly, you can used those ramps to deflect your shots around corners! These ramps can also be bought at the store and loaded into either Poindexter or Mary. The store is a Shooterland player's best friend!
Don't forget that if Poindexter gets blocked on the right then Mary cannot shoot as well, and you will surely lose! Make sure he has some space and use ramps to complete this level.
See that block by the broccoli up top? If you put the correct ramp there, you'll easilly be able to squash that Cronie! Always look for when ramps can make your life easier!
There are usually many ways to complete each level. Find the quickest one so you can get the star for the level!

Cronies used to have limbs back during the Mesozoic Era. But, scientists propose that Cronies evolved into limbless balls so that they could roll away from predators with minimal effort. This ability makes them fantastic soccer balls.

These Cronies are hermits. I don't think they ever really came out of that cave before. I don't even think they've really done anything to support Rosco's evil deeds. I think I babysat the one Cronie, "Betty" was her name, back about ten years ago. Her family was really nice and payed $25 an hour. We played with tinker toys all night. Anyways, I guess you better kill them.
These Cronies stole candy from babies. They deserve to die!
Rosco is getting frustrated! He just sent in this entire regiment of Cronies from his secret army. He's showing signs of weakness! Keep up the good work!

Poindexter and Mary both have some very rare disease called the flu which makes them randomly change size! When they get larger, they shoot more than one thingy at once. Poindexter and Mary can still shoot as long as at least one thingy will be shot by each of them. This is a very important thing to remember!

This is the last level of Foodville! After completing this level, you can continue onto the next world as long as you have at least 10 stars. If you don't, just go back to the levels you have already completed and try and beat the time-to-beat for each!

Rosco is quite angry at the Cronies for not stopping you in your tracks. He has now deployed an army of a new enemy - the Crazy! Crazies are very similar to Cronies except they do not die to combos. Only bombs and weights are able to defeat this foe!

Do you know why Crazies are called Crazies? It comes from the Apache word "crahhsi" which was used to describe small, green, cylindrical objects such as the empty food cans tourists like to throw on their reservations in New Mexico.
These Crazies were caught trying to kidnap some of Rosco's children. That's why they're locked up. Even though they may be against Rosco, they cannot be trusted!
Don't forget you can buy ramps! I know they're expensive, but so is everything else nowadays. Remember to be frugal, for Rosco is constantly robbing you!
Using multiple ramps in succession can be confusing at first, but it's sometimes necessary. Just make sure to keep the paths to the Crazies clear enough for you to get them!

Those grey blocks with the picture of the Cronie on them are called "enemy blocks." They're indestructable and immovable. The only way to destroy them is to defeat all of the type of enemy drawn on the block.

The Crazies are very social animals. They live in large groups called "suffles" and feed mainly on small rodents and bugs. To fend off possible predators, a suffle of Crazies will stack on top of one another, forming a giant totem-pole-like structure and begin clicking.

When you use a bowling bomb to destroy an object, it becomes destroyed immediately. This means thingies shot from the other shooter with the same click may pass through this space as long as the bowling bomb gets there first.
To get to those Cronies in the corner, you are going to have to destroy all of the Crazies first. Every type of enemy has their own enemy block.

If you ever forget how an enemy can be killed, just open the pause menu during the game. Each row corresponds to a different enemy, and the columns correspond to different ways to defeat them. The first column is bowling bombs, the second is combos, the third is crushing with weights, and the last is land mines (these won't be seen until world four!).
Those brown blocks are made out of Frunhorpus, a fragile igneous rock. These blocks can be destroyed with bowling bombs or simply pushed with weights. Oh boy!

It's quite easy to tell a male Crazy from a female Crazy - simply multiply the number of spots on its head by the number of teeth, divide by 8 and add how many chins their mother has. If this number is nearly divisible by any prime number or its square-root, you can be 34 percent sure you have a male Crazy on your hands!

You can destroy ramps with bowling bombs if you shoot the bomb onto one of the ramp's flat sides. This is the only way to get rid of ramps, so be careful not to overuse them and clutter the level board!

It's usually a good idea to examine a level and plan out some sort of strategy before beginning the game, especially if you are going for the level star. Just rushing into levels without thought won't help you make those times!

In the wild, Cronies and Crazies are on the same level of the food chain. An almost symbiotic relationship exists between the two in some ecosystems. For example, the Cronie will eat the slime off of the Crazies' backs for nutrients, thus enabling the Crazies to see out their third eye located on their backs to watch for predators such as Fangies.
You can use ramps to redirect other ramps that you shoot at them. This enables you to create very elaborate paths to shoot your thingies!

If you beat this level without using any ramps, 
 
 YOU ARE A CHEATER! 
 
 RANK: 
 CHEATER!

Rosco has deployed yet another new enemy! See the chubby blob with the chef hat? He's a Fatty. Fatties can only be killed with weights or by combos of 4 or more thingies. Combos of 3 thingies will do nothing against them!

The Fatties are Rosco's slaves he uses to cook for he and his army. They're not the greatest warriors, but their layers of lard and cellulite are enough to shield them from the most powerful explosives. For this reason, along with desperation, they have been sent to the front line.
Remember that brown blocks can be both destroyed with bowling bombs and pushed with weights!
Freddy the Fatty has a serious sea food obsession, so these Cronies are trying to shield him from it. Now that they're distracted, attack!
Ramps pointing in this direction can be dangerous. Shots from one shooter can end up blocking the other shooter's shots.

Fatties used to be found in the wild and were called Skinnies. Then they became domesticated, overfed, lazy, and evil Fatties. Rosco went around all of Shooterland years ago, Fattienapping from all of the citizens. He trained these Fatties to cook, and cook darn well, for he knew he would need a lot of food to support his army he planned to raise!

Fatties are obsessive compulsive. They must change their chef hats daily or they begin having nervous breakdowns. For this reason, huge landfills of chef hats are found throughout Shooterland. This wasteful habit made the shooters resent the Fatties, and in turn made the two groups quick enemies.

This is the end of Fishypoo Ocean! 
 
 After this level, if you have 25 stars or more, you can continue on to the next world! If not, just return to previously completed levels and get the stars for them!

You're doing a great job so far! Rosco has retreated to the dense forests of Treefinger Farm! This is a dangerous area - it is home to the rare but extremely violent Fangie. Rumor has it that Rosco has trained many of them to fight by his side. This is not good news at all!
So why is Rosco stealing all of this money? To save up to put his 5 kids in college. Tuition costs are getting ridiculous these days.
